eps.d: Dennis eludes a babysitter to go to the movies that his parents are at.

eps.t: The Day They Took Gnasher Away
eps.d: Dennis replaces a fallen signpost... backwards.
Henry and Mr.Wilson try to go fishing without Dennis.
Dennis tries to fix his Grampa Perkins up with Miss Cathcart.
Mr. Wilson thinks he has discovered a space satellite.

Mr. Wilson's garden originally consisted of Dahlia bulbs. When Dennis sees them, he thinks they are ""sweet potatoes"" and after his bedtime, he ""secretly exchanges"" what is in his garden with what is in Mr. Wilson's garden. Dennis eventually raises the Dahlia bulbs & wins a 1st prize medal. After the garden judges see Mr. Wilson's garden, he is also given a medal.
Dennis helps Mr Wilson sell a neighbors house.

Dennis and Tommy camp out in the back yard. Dennis' parents friends The Melton's play a record containing wild animal sounds to entertain the boys while they are camping out in the yard. Mr. Wilson can hear the record from his house and is convinced that wild animals have escaped from the circus and are after the boys so Mr. Wilson goes out to the yard to try and save Dennis and Tommy from danger.

Dennis thinks his dad is broke so he sells bottles to try and help his dad out. However, when Dennis tells some of the neighbors what he is doing the neighbors get the wrong idea about the Mitchell's and think that they are in trouble financially.
Dennis starts a rumor that him and his family are moving to New York only to keep Mr. Wilson in town to get his award.
Dennis is going crazy trying to find his gifts.
Dennis meets Whip Crawford his cowboy idol after Mrs Webster tells Dennis he will be in the play.
Dennis Haunts Mr. Wilson's house due to him and his friends starting a club house in Mr. Wilson's basement.
Mr. Wilson gets a visit from his former boss who offers him his job back in Pittsburgh. When Dennis thinks Mr. Wilson is moving to Pittsburgh, he runs away from home.
Mr. Wilson's Niece is getting married and asks Dennis to be the ring bear.

Mr. Wilson gives Dennis an old radio set that he mistakenly bid for at an auction. However, When Dennis finds money in his radio set, Mr. Wilson gets excited. So him and Mitchell put in add in the paper hoping the real owner isn't around to claim it.
Dennis gets what he thinks is a hampster which turns out to be a gopher that escapes from his cage and almost ruins Mr. Wilson's yard.

Mr. Wilson has a stock certificate worth $500. He hides it in his Phone book, however when Dennis brings him in his new phone book Mr. Wilson goes crazy and ends up going to the warehouse where all the old phonebooks are taken to look for his old phone book because he thinks the stock is still in it.
Dennis tries to take care of his mom because she is sick and his dad is out of town.
Dennis starts a rock collection and ends up finding what he thinks is real gold on Mr. Wilson's lot
Mr. Wilson tricks Mr. Mitchell out of playing golf to spend more time with Dennis.

Dennis wants to help out for Paint-up, Clean-up week. So Mr. Wilson gives Dennis a bucket of red paint to paint his wagon with. Dennis however also decides to paint the street curve by Mr. Wilson's house and Mr. Wilson gets blamed for it.

eps.t: Journey to the Centre of the Bed
eps.d: Dennis is very upset because he doesn't know how to whistle, So he spends all day trying to learn how.
Dennis gets an electric car for his mom from the lady who won the Raffle.
Dennis is determined to get a horse for Christmas, So on Christmas day he goes around the neighborhood trying to find what he thinks is his horse.
Dennis is trying to learn about how to earn money by working. His dad eventually starts him on an allowance.
